name: Health Coach
tagline: Turn sleep, recovery and lab numbers into one daily coaching brief
description: Collects the numbers your watch, training app and lab results produce and puts them side by side, then writes a short daily brief saying what to change tomorrow. Because the summary lands in one readable place, other bots in your setup can read it too. Setup notes cover the Android-emulation layer it needs on Linux.
author: branpurn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
